target_customer: Self-custody crypto holders who worry their heirs could not recover their funds
problem: Holders of their own keys risk permanent loss of funds if they die or are incapacitated, because no one else can access the wallet.
business_model: Software subscription or fee for on-chain inheritance contracts (not stated by the company)

founders.name: Kartik Sathappan
founders.background_notes: YC page bio lists these companies as worked at or with; now GP at Families Fund.

founders.name: Samraaj Bath
founders.background_notes: YC page bio says he is CEO of Dynamite, has been through YC twice and built an LLM powered Figma to code tool.

competitors.name: Sarcophagus
competitors.what: Decentralized dead man's switch protocol on Ethereum using Arweave storage, for inheritance and instructions on incapacity
competitors.funding_then: Raised about $5.47M from VCs via a DAO round (Decrypt coverage)

technical_complexity.rationale: Dead man's switch smart contracts are conceptually simple, but a small team had to get contract security and a recoverable user experience right.

defensibility.rationale: The mechanism is a public smart contract pattern that other protocols such as Sarcophagus already offered; no data or network lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying Bifrost; later entrants (Bron, 2026) added inheritance flows to wallets.

market_need_then: Lost crypto keys and inheritance were a recurring concern in self-custody coverage, but no dated spend or customer data was found for 2022.

branding.domain_note: YC lists hapi.finance as the website, which currently serves a Namecheap parking page; the relationship to Bifrost is unclear.

brand_strength.rationale: Bifrost is the name of many projects (a Polkadot DeFi network, other startups) so the name was confusable, and no press about the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: The cause of Bifrost's inactive status is not public. No shutdown post, funding news or press about the company was found, the listed domain is a parking page, and both founders have moved on to other roles. Without a stated cause, no failure factor is assigned.
notes: Funding searches returned only other companies named Bifrost (Bifrost Finance raised $600K seed, UK Bifrost $1.14M seed), which are not this company; none_found is therefore not evidence of no funding. A third party directory suggests a rebrand to hapi.finance but hapi.finance is an unrelated investing app and the claim is unverified. The one competitor is from a Jan 2022 post; Casa was also named in later articles but no dated source was found. Brand search turned up only the Norse myth; name origin is not sourced.
